quick_skim.title: Accelerating Dynamic Route Re-solving via Robust Solver Evolution in Automatic Heuristic Design
quick_skim.abstract: Multi-goal route planning uses spatial data on service locations and pairwise travel costs to determine a visiting order that minimizes total travel cost. This task can be formulated as the traveling salesman problem (TSP) and has benefited from large language model-based automatic heuristic design (AHD) for constructing effective solvers. Despite their effectiveness in static settings, existing methods exhibit substantial re-solving inefficiency when location changes, new requests, or request cancellations alter the underlying request data during execution. Our empirical analysis suggests that ``static-overfitting'' contributes to this inefficiency, as evolved solvers may repeatedly direct search toward overlapping local neighborhoods after dynamic changes. We further find that this ``overfitting'' is associated with limitations in existing evolutionary processes, where lower objective values on some instances coincide with longer solving times. In this paper, we therefore propose ERDR, a plug-and-play framework that integrates two strategies into existing AHD pipelines to guide evolution toward solvers that re-solve dynamically changed instances faster. Specifically, 1) ERDR uses validation-guided reselection to reevaluate candidates on instances excluded from routine evolution, reducing specialization to fixed training instances. 2) ERDR applies runtime robustness-augmented evaluation, supplementing the original evaluation objective of AHD methods with inter-group variability and tail risk in solving time to discourage costly and uneven search. Experiments across multiple TSP scales and dynamic scenarios show that ERDR achieves average re-solving speedups of $2.2\times$ under guided local search and $4.4\times$ under iterated local search.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Addresses static-overfitting of LLM-evolved TSP heuristics that hurts re-solving when requests change, proposing robust solver evolution to accelerate dynamic re-optimization.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 多目标路径规划可建模为TSP，基于大模型的自动启发式设计已能构造有效求解器，但当位置变化或请求增删导致数据改变时，已有方法重求解效率低下。该文分析发现静态过拟合会使演化求解器反复陷入重叠的局部邻域，进而提出鲁棒的求解器演化方法以加速动态重求解。该工作属于现代TSP启发式自动设计方向，对理解ATSP的启发式求解有借鉴意义，但未专门讨论非对称情形。

quick_skim.llm_title_zh: 通过自动启发式设计中的鲁棒求解器演化加速动态路径重求解
quick_skim.llm_motivation_cn: 大模型演化的TSP启发式在静态场景有效，但请求变化时重求解效率低，源于静态过拟合。
quick_skim.llm_method_cn: 分析静态过拟合现象，并提出鲁棒求解器演化方法改进自动启发式设计流程。
quick_skim.llm_result_cn: 实验显示所提演化策略能缓解局部邻域重叠，加快动态场景下的重求解。
quick_skim.llm_conclusion_cn: 该工作拓展了TSP启发式的自动设计，对ATSP启发式求解有间接启发。
